policy: Before adding any private runtime plugin or managed N.E.K.O core patch, review N.E.K.O native/upstream capability and mature external components. Reuse wins unless a concrete acceptance gap remains. run_checks.ps1 fails closed when a runtime customization lacks an approved review.

reviews.problem: Internal proactive session start incorrectly refreshes user-activity authority.

candidates.name: N.E.K.O native proactive runtime
candidates.outcome: gap_is_inside_authority

reviews.why_reuse_insufficient: This is an internal N.E.K.O lifecycle race; an external component cannot repair the authority ordering without replacing the runtime.

reviews.problem: Full Chat hides the already-native microphone control.

candidates.name: N.E.K.O native microphone/realtime runtime
candidates.outcome: reused; only UI bridge missing

reviews.why_reuse_insufficient: Native runtime is reused; patch only exposes its existing control in the active surface.

reviews.problem: Qwen3.8 semantic VAD accepted PCM without completing speech detection in live E2E.

candidates.name: Qwen3.8 server_vad
candidates.outcome: selected

reviews.why_reuse_insufficient: Uses provider-native server VAD; only N.E.K.O's model-specific selection needed correction.

reviews.problem: User PCM activity is published too late when the shared worker is backpressured.

candidates.name: N.E.K.O native user-priority/activity signal
candidates.outcome: reused but emitted too late

reviews.why_reuse_insufficient: External VAD/ASR cannot fix the internal queue/lock ordering; patch reuses the same native RMS signal before queueing.

reviews.problem: Rapid character switching can drop the latest intent and leave the VRM torn down.

candidates.name: N.E.K.O native character/VRM renderer
candidates.outcome: reused; state-machine recovery missing

reviews.why_reuse_insufficient: The bug is in N.E.K.O's own switch state machine; replacing the renderer would be larger and duplicate more functionality.

reviews.problem: An independent assistant-speech mute can create policy-induced text-only replies; the required contract is one whole-reply quiet gate before text/TTS split.

candidates.name: N.E.K.O existing text publication + TTS output paths
candidates.outcome: reused; no native single admission boundary exposed to the private plugin

reviews.why_reuse_insufficient: The native text and TTS pipelines are reused unchanged after admission. The narrow patch only supplies the missing opt-in common boundary so private quiet intent cannot split text from its paired audio.

reviews.problem: Qwen3.8 auto tool selection skips a negative recent-activity question.

candidates.name: Qwen3.8-Omni native tool_choice with reasoning_effort=none
candidates.outcome: verified 1/1 for previously failing case; preferred execution mechanism

candidates.name: N.E.K.O plugin SDK @llm_tool
candidates.outcome: registration reused; no synchronous per-turn tool-choice arbitration hook

reviews.why_reuse_insufficient: Provider-native forced tool is used directly. The remaining patch is only a generic per-turn bridge because N.E.K.O has no configuration/plugin hook to select first-round tool_choice from private policy and then restore ordinary reasoning.

reviews.problem: Owner natural-language interaction controls need deterministic native state changes; retrospective activity needs a queryable source.

candidates.name: N.E.K.O proactive_controller and conversation settings
candidates.outcome: selected as hard execution authority

candidates.name: ActivityWatch 0.14.3
candidates.outcome: selected as recent-activity authority; private duplicate timeline is being removed

reviews.why_reuse_insufficient: The plugin remains only semantic intent mediation and a read-only bridge to native/external authorities; it must not own a second memory, proactive engine, vision runtime, or activity datastore.

reviews.problem: XiaoYu needs a first-class paired Qwen clone, and preview/conversation/realtime must share one persisted speech-rate authority rather than diverging.

candidates.name: N.E.K.O existing structured character voice storage/picker
candidates.outcome: selected as the only local voice binding and UI authority

candidates.name: N.E.K.O existing Qwen3.8 Omni realtime transport
candidates.outcome: selected for realtime speech; paired cloned voice is passed only on exact provider/model match

candidates.name: Alibaba Model Studio Qwen-Audio voice enrollment and TTS HTTP APIs
candidates.outcome: selected for ordinary clone creation, text synthesis and preview

candidates.name: Alibaba Model Studio Qwen Omni voice enrollment API
candidates.outcome: selected for the matching Qwen3.8 Omni realtime clone created from the same reference sample

candidates.name: Generic N.E.K.O CosyVoice preview path
candidates.outcome: rejected for qwen_bundle after live preview returned InvalidParameter / engine 418

candidates.name: Legacy qwen3-tts-vc-realtime-2026-01-15
candidates.outcome: rejected after live provider response: model no longer exists

candidates.name: N.E.K.O / audiolab existing tempo pipeline
candidates.outcome: selected for pitch-preserving speech-rate application; no custom DSP implementation

reviews.why_reuse_insufficient: Durable authorities remain reused: N.E.K.O owns voice storage/picking/runtime, Alibaba owns enrollment and synthesis, and audiolab owns pitch-preserving tempo. The thin patch only exposes paired enrollment/routing, binds one shared speech_rate to those native paths, and refreshes the matching TTS worker when it changes.

reviews.problem: Mini-game invitations can interrupt the owner while they are still doing work; the work-break path additionally defaults to a 50% chance of turning a rest reminder into a game invitation.

candidates.name: N.E.K.O ActivityPreferences.work_break_game_invite_probability
candidates.outcome: selected for the work-break combo; XiaoYu sets the supported native preference to 0.0 and keeps the ordinary mini-game feature enabled

candidates.name: N.E.K.O ActivitySnapshot state / propensity
candidates.outcome: selected as the only ordinary-invite availability authority; casual_browsing and idle are the explicit leisure allowlist

candidates.name: N.E.K.O proactive Phase-2 user-directive gate
candidates.outcome: insufficient for canned mini-game invitations because that delivery path bypasses Phase 2; upstream documentation already records this as #3013

reviews.why_reuse_insufficient: Native config fully solves the work-break combo and is used there. For ordinary canned invitations, no existing plugin/config hook narrows eligibility to explicit leisure states before delivery. The patch adds only that state admission check and reuses all existing invitation, probability, cooldown, delivery and game logic.
